Metadata.Goal: Restore protocol-correct DeepSeek interleaved thinking and tool-call continuation for new and historical sessions.
Metadata.Description: Preserve reasoning_content independently from TUI display filtering and add a DeepSeek-only legacy request fallback.

TaskSpace.name: fix-deepseek-thinking-tool-roundtrip
TaskSpace.Description: Characterize and repair DeepSeek reasoning continuation across stream aggregation, provider projection, and historical session recovery.

TaskGroup.name: Protocol regression characterization
TaskGroup.Description: Add deterministic failing tests for empty, mirrored, and historically missing DeepSeek reasoning fields.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Focused tests demonstrate the current field-loss behavior before production code changes.
OpenAI isolation is covered alongside DeepSeek compatibility.

Task.name: Add failing DeepSeek roundtrip regressions
Task.Description: Add stream aggregation and chat normalization regressions for empty reasoning, mirrored reasoning, historical missing reasoning, and ordinary OpenAI isolation.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: A stream test requires an observed empty reasoning_content field to remain present.
A stream test requires mirrored reasoning to remain available for wire roundtrip without duplicate think emission.
Normalization tests require DeepSeek legacy tool calls to receive an empty compatibility field and OpenAI messages to remain unchanged.

TaskGroup.name: Adapter protocol repair
TaskGroup.Description: Separate wire reasoning preservation from display filtering and repair DeepSeek message normalization.

Task.name: Implement field-preserving DeepSeek continuation
Task.Description: Track reasoning field presence and wire content in the stream adapter, preserve empty values during normalization, and apply a DeepSeek-only fallback to historical assistant tool-call messages.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: buildMessage preserves observed reasoning_content even when empty or mirrored.
Mirrored reasoning may be hidden from display events without being removed from the returned protocol message.
DeepSeek request normalization preserves real values and repairs only missing historical tool-call fields.
Ordinary OpenAI request normalization does not receive the DeepSeek fallback.

TaskGroup.name: Continuation verification
TaskGroup.Description: Verify serialized provider requests and the incident-compatible continuation path.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Focused stream, chat helper, fetch adapter, and provider context tests pass.
Diff review confirms no session rewrite or unrelated provider changes.

Task.name: Verify multi-turn request payload and incident compatibility
Task.Description: Add or extend a transport-level test that serializes assistant tool calls and tool results, then run focused regressions and read-only verification against the recorded incident shape.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: The serialized DeepSeek request contains assistant content, reasoning_content, tool_calls, followed by the matching tool result.
A historical assistant tool-call message without reasoning_content is projected with the compatibility field.
Focused tests pass; package type checks are documented as environment-blocked by missing workspace type declarations.
